summary: Frontend-only regression for the revised EPERSONEL site: unified HeroSystem, StepsShowcase, updated METRICS, LogoBand, premium SocialIcons, WhatsApp removal from contact, EP pricing active state, EPapp/EPgo new hero visuals, and mobile responsiveness. All requested testids, flows, and copy verified. No console errors observed; no regressions on EP/EPfood/EPapp/EPgo pages.
critical_code_review_comments: EP pricing testid uses Turkish slug 'pricing-ep-başlangıç' (with diacritics) — works but review request referenced 'pricing-ep-start'. Consider standardising to ASCII slugs (start/plus/pro) for more robust automated testing.
Contact email testid is 'contact-card-eposta' (not 'contact-card-email'); acceptable but non-obvious for external consumers.

METRICS counters only animate when the section scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver via Reveal). This is expected but means viewport-agnostic tests will read '0K+' initial state; consider adding an aria-label or data-value for testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: hero-system-hub persists across 4 hero tabs (ep/epapp/epfood/epgo scenes swap in place). steps-section renders with step-tab-0..3 and steps-visual-{entegrasyon|siparis|hazirla|teslim}; steps-flow text = 'Entegre et → Sipariş al → Hazırla → Teslim et'. Metrics section renders 4 tiles (labels: Yönetilen Ürün / Firma Epersonel'de / Şube / Panel / Yönetilen Sipariş); counter animates on scroll. logo-band renders and all 8 referans names present. Footer socials point to linkedin.com/company/epersonel and instagram.com/epersonel; footer solution labels are UPPERCASE EP/EPAPP/EPFOOD/EPGO. Contact page has only telefon, eposta, instagram, linkedin cards — contact-card-whatsapp is absent as expected. EP pricing: 3 cards present (pricing-ep-başlangıç, pricing-ep-plus, pricing-ep-pro); pricing-ep-plus default active with border-brand class. system-visual-ep and system-visual-epfood render. epapp-flow renders with hub + channels 0/1/2. epgo-map renders with '3,5 km', 'Mağaza', '30–45 dakika', 'Frigolu', 'Randevulu' labels. Mobile 375px: hero-system-hub visible, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=375). No console errors captured.
